review:
Easy to read and nice to play: 243 ways, classic fruits, and a scatter tracker above the reels that shows you how many scatters have landed. Falling star multipliers give the base game a bit of extra spark.

Three, four or five scatters give 10, 15 or 25 free spins, with random multipliers on wins. There's also a Magic Spins mode where every win gets a fixed multiplier. Medium volatility, a 1,500x cap and an excellent 97.04% RTP. Free spins come about once every 207 spins. A good pick for a relaxed session.
pros: Excellent 97.04% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
